draft_key_information_units.information: Revenue increased by 22.4% to MEUR 86,970 thousand (MEUR 87.0) in Q1 2026 compared to Q1 2025.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Main financial indicators table shows Revenue Q1 2024: 56,192; Q1 2025: 71,072; Q1 2026: 86,970 with change 22.4%. Text states 'revenue During Q1 2026 consolidated increased by 22.4%, compared to the same period last year and amounted to MEUR 87.0.'

draft_key_information_units.information: EBITDA decreased by 50.2% to MEUR 3,003 thousand (MEUR 3.0) in Q1 2026, excluding preliminary negative goodwill of MEUR 5.5 related to the Marijampolės acquisition.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Main financial indicators table shows EBITDA Q1 2024: 6,446; Q1 2025: 6,031; Q1 2026: 3,003 with change -50.2%. Text states 'In Q1 2026 EBITDA excludes preliminary negative goodwill of MEUR 5.5 related to the acquisition of Marijampolės pieno konservai UAB.'

draft_key_information_units.information: Net profit increased by 25.7% to MEUR 5,085 thousand (MEUR 5.1) in Q1 2026 compared to Q1 2025.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Main financial indicators table shows Net profit Q1 2024: 4,923; Q1 2025: 4,045; Q1 2026: 5,085 with change 25.7%. Text states 'In the first three months of 2026, the Group's net profit amounted to MEUR 5.1, which was 25.7% higher than in the same period of 2025.'

draft_key_information_units.information: Acquired 100% shares of Marijampolės pieno konservai UAB on 16 January 2026, adding canned milk and milk powder production facilities.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Main events section states 'On 16 January 2026, Vilkyškių pieninė AB completed the transaction for the acquisition of shares of Marijampolės pieno konservai UAB. 100% of the company’s shares were acquired.' Further details describe its two production facilities for canned milk and milk powder.

draft_key_information_units.information: Commercial cheese production commenced at Baltic Dairy Board SIA's new factory in Bauska, Latvia, with planned annual production of 18 thousand tons and creation of over 100 jobs, exporting to more than 40 countries.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Main events section states 'VILVI Group has started commercial cheese production in Latvia... factory will create more than 100 jobs, and the planned cheese production volumes will reach 18 thousand tons per year. These products will be exported to more than 40 countries worldwide.'

draft_key_information_units.information: Net financial debt increased by 89.7% to MEUR 83,427 thousand (MEUR 83.4) in Q1 2026 compared to Q1 2025.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Main financial indicators table shows Net financial debt Q1 2024: 20,560; Q1 2025: 43,971; Q1 2026: 83,427 with change 89.7%.

draft_key_information_units.information: Segment revenue structure shifted with canned milk contributing 14% of total revenue (new from acquisition), dry milk products up 126.9% to MEUR 24,659 thousand, cheese products up 43% to MEUR 37,641 thousand, and fresh milk products up 73.4% to MEUR 12,748 thousand.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Sales revenue by operating segments table shows Q1 2026 values and percentage changes. Picture text confirms 'Canned milk 14%', 'Dry milk products 28%', and other segment percentages.

draft_key_information_units.information: Revenue geography shifted with Lithuania's share rising to 17% of total from 12%, European Union remaining at 59%, and other countries increasing to 34% from 29%.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Sales revenue by markets table shows Q1 2026 percentages: European Union 49% (42,518/86,970), Lithuania 17% (14,633/86,970), Other countries 34% (29,818/86,970). Picture text confirms these percentages for Q1 2026.

evaluation.selection_rationale: Units D1-D3 cover headline financial performance (revenue, EBITDA, net profit) with year-over-year changes. D4 and D5 capture major strategic and operational developments (acquisition and new cheese production launch). D6 addresses material liquidity change. D7 and D8 provide segment and geographic revenue breakdowns, which are key drivers of the reported performance. All units represent independently omittable material themes directly supported by the source report, excluding routine boilerplate. Priority was given to central performance indicators, major explicit drivers, and significant structural changes as per evaluation guidelines.
